subject: social
grouping_policy: Rule: subquestions that use a shared map, table, figure, conversation or document stay in one unit; subquestions that use none of the shared material are separate units. When unsure (or when a page layout would force another subquestion into the crop), keep together. Groups defined from the problem pages only, without answer-key content.

corrections.note: Official problem correction (PDF page 1): page 9, question 6, line 1 「の間におこった」 -> 「のころにおこった」. The body page in this PDF is uncorrected.

answer_format: Mark sheet. Each 問 answers one choice: ア〜エ, ア〜カ (combination tables, orderings), or ア〜コ (pairs of statements a〜e). No 二つ選べ question. Common instruction item 8 (multiple answers, one choice per answer row) included as common_instructions.
